title: Operation “Trolling Stone”: Russia-linked influence activity
summary: OpenAI banned accounts linked to a previously unreported operation we dubbed "Trolling Stone", using AI to generate comments about an alleged Russian cult leader’s arrest in Argentina.
body: OpenAI banned accounts linked to a previously unreported operation we dubbed "Trolling Stone", using AI to generate comments about an alleged Russian cult leader’s arrest in Argentina.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布报告称封禁了名为“Trolling Stone”的俄罗斯相关账号，该组织利用AI生成虚假评论以进行舆论影响。此事件体现了AI在内容生成与社会工程学攻击中的潜在风险，强调了模型厂商在安全合规与滥用监测方面的责任。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该报告揭示了AI被用于虚假信息传播的实际案例，对大模型安全治理具有参考意义。
